name: Positive Tails
region_note: HELP PAYING VET BILLS - funds and lists from the Mayor's Alliance vet care page, checked 2026-11-03. Most have eligibility rules; read them before applying.
notes: A Brooklyn-based 501(c)(3) that pays for lifesaving vet treatment in a crisis for people who cannot afford it, and for animals that were abandoned or abused, and runs free and low-cost spay/neuter days across the city. Mailing address P.O. Box 27192, Brooklyn, NY 11202.
type_raw: Nonprofit that pays for spay/neuter and lifesaving vet treatment for New Yorkers who cannot afford it
